hints.title: Root Fixed Position
hints.text: The first element in the list is always inserted as the root of the BST.

hints.title: Left and Right Partitioning
hints.text: Partition all other elements into left sub-elements (< root) and right sub-elements (> root).

hints.title: Combinatorial Interleaving Formula
hints.text: The relative order within left and right must be preserved, yielding comb(L + R, L) * ways(left) * ways(right).

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import math

class Solution:
    def numOfWays(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        def count_ways(arr):
            if len(arr) <= 2:
                return 1
            root = arr[0]
            left = [x for x in arr[1:] if x < root]
            right = [x for x in arr[1:] if x > root]
            ways = math.comb(len(left) + len(right), len(left)) % MOD
            return (ways * count_ways(left) * count_ways(right)) % MOD
        return (count_ways(nums) - 1) % MOD
```

complexity.notes: Partitioning array elements recursively takes O(N^2) time in the worst case and O(N log N) on average.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating and testing all N! permutations causes factorial time out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Divide and conquer with combination math counts valid permutations without generating them.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Divide-and-conquer recursion interleaving left and right subtrees via combinations.
